author: anistark
title: Mandala
description: A sand mandala made grain by grain on a board at night, by lamplight or candlelight, on wood, marble, stone, sand or grass. Chalk lines mark it out, coloured sand fills it from the centre outward, and when it is finished it is swept away into water and a new one begins. No two are the same.

card: A sand mandala made grain by grain on a board at night, on a floor and among lamps, incense and offerings that change every night. Chalk lines mark it out, then coloured sand goes down from the centre outward, every line traced and every section filled. Finished, it rests for 42 seconds before it is cut, swept into a heap and poured into a bowl of water, and a new one begins.
